parameters.note: Lake Lois is a high alpine lake in the Desolation Wilderness (El Dorado Co.), on the Pacific slope in the Rubicon River / American River drainage — its outlet drains northeast toward the Lake Schmidell / Rockbound Valley reach of the Rubicon River, west of the Sierra crest that forms the Lake Tahoe basin rim, so it is not a Lake Tahoe tributary and the special Lake Tahoe tributary closure (§7.50(b)(152)) does not apply. Not listed by name in §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so the general statewide lake regulation §5.85(a)(1) governs: open all year, 5/10.

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)
